end.parentNote: Vihaan practised finding how much is needed to make 100 and counting jumps on a number line. They used useful methods such as matching tens and ones and splitting a journey into smaller jumps. There was a mix-up while explaining 87 and 13, and it was not clearly corrected by the last response. At home, ask Vihaan to show each answer with tens and ones or with jumps on a drawn number line.
